title: OA MONSTERS - the Nat: the three lesser spirits of hearth, village, and grave
audit_comment: OA round one hundred twelve (capture pp. 276-278): the Chapter 12 monster roster - the nat, the three lesser spirits of the tropics - the stat table and the three descriptions riding together, the AC 0 of the hkum yang colliding with the table sentinel (an R722-class find), single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA MONSTERS - THE NAT, printed capture pp. 276-278 - the lesser spirit round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift

bools.name: dkmHkumAnimateFireWood
bools.comment: the animate powers - animate fire and animate wood, three times per day (print capture p. 277)

bools.name: dkmHkumDailyPowers
bools.comment: the hkum yang daily powers - quell and remove curse once per day (print capture p. 277)

bools.name: dkmHkumWeeklyPowers
bools.comment: the hkum yang weekly power - ancient curse once per week (print capture p. 277)

bools.comment: the lair - always found in a graveyard or cemetery, where it disturbs the rest of the dead (print capture p. 277)

bools.name: dkmLuDailyPowers
bools.comment: the lu daily powers - water to poison and wood rot once per day (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dkmLuDiseaseCloud
bools.comment: the disease cloud - surrounded by an invisible cloud of disease (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dkmLuCloudSaveVsDeath
bools.comment: the cloud save - all within must make a successful saving throw vs. death each round spent in the cloud or become afflicted with a rotting disease (print capture p. 278)

bools.name: dkmLuNoHealingUntilCured
bools.comment: the cure clause - until cured the victim cannot heal naturally or benefit from healing spells (print capture p. 278)
